column1: # The expiring baseline of the deploy-channel trio consumers: every (file, name) pair that names

# (a FALLBACK:<NAME> row records a read that falls back to another credential). It SHRINKS ONLY:
#   - a row absent from the merge-base copy of this file is RED (a new consumer is a reviewed decision);
#   - a row whose consumer no longer reads the name is RED (the PR that moves a consumer deletes its row);
#   - a row past its expiry is RED (the move, or a reviewed re-date with the CLO and CTO's sequencing in the plan).
# The final G1 PR asserts this file holds no rows. There is no permanent allowlist (ADR-241 D8).
# Columns (tab-separated): file, name, expires (YYYY-MM-DD), issue tag (#9294:PR-2 | PR-3 | PR-4).
